name: framework
breaks_up: a framework, by how its name binds what follows and how what it collects is kept and reached
left_out: Voice: the Museum speaks as itself and through its columnists, but no text of it sets two voices against each other, so voice is not yet a type. A pool other than a uniform one: the Museum's texts name only the uniform side. Whether rooms belong to every framework or only to the Museum stays untested until a second framework is described here.

element_types.name: stance
element_types.description: How the framework's name binds what follows.

elements.name: pronouncement
elements.description: the name means what is pronounced: a specification that binds whatever follows

elements.name: description
elements.description: the name means what was found by careful observation and analysis

elements.name: uniform
elements.description: a fixed content pool with one type of content, which becomes a body with a presence of its own

element_types.name: rooms
element_types.description: The containers the pool is kept in, each with its own condition for entry.

elements.name: sanctuary
elements.description: ideas allowed to persist without evidence of their having any value

elements.name: shrine
elements.description: desires that were cultural forces and are not any more

elements.name: books
elements.description: annotations on books, which are social beings

elements.name: offices
elements.description: a stage for the public performance of an institution

element_types.name: access
element_types.description: How widely the framework is open, against how intensely it is held: the more the access, the less the intensity.

elements.name: wide
elements.description: open to anyone, held less intensely

elements.name: narrow
elements.description: open to few, held more intensely

element_types.name: count
element_types.description: Whether the framework knows how many it reaches.

elements.name: not known
elements.description: no number is kept, so it can be anything, zero or infinite

instances.name: Museum of Vestigial Desire
instances.what: the framework the syntax is read from: a museum, begun in 2012, of desires that have outlived their objects
